raw_report.scope: Fresh training episodes at the saved curriculum clock. Native Gaussian act/process/GAE only. No optimizer update, no checkpoint written, no mid-rollout replay or fixed-case acceptance claim.
raw_report.interpretation: Group-conditioned credit and noise moments are descriptive score estimates before PPO clipping/epochs, not a unique cause or guaranteed update direction. Post-warmup populations explicitly exclude episode age <=1s. No optimization or learning/curriculum clock advance occurred.

event_attribution.interpretation: Linear GAE reward component with recorded transitions/critic and zero event-tail value. Removing it is an offline algebraic intervention, not learning or a policy-return improvement.

scope: Native once-per-failure payment is read without changing its returned tensor. Event GAE uses the original ownership/bootstrap/done boundaries. Counterfactual reward arithmetic holds transitions, actor, critic and all states fixed; it is not retraining or causal evidence of better tracking.
